derivation: from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and a derivative of the base of G5157 (τροπή) (meaning well-turned, i.e. ready at repartee, jocose);
def: witticism, i.e. (in a vulgar sense) ribaldry

occurrences.text: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
